posts.title: Why I'm taking on this challenge
posts.cover_caption: Sample photo – replace with your own
posts.body:
I've eaten plant-based for a while, but I want to do **more than change my own plate**. Over the coming months I'll be working with Plant-Based Cambridge to get academics signing the open letter, and sharing resources to help anyone who wants to make the switch.

This is a sample post so you can see how things look. Edit or delete it from the `/admin` page.

> Individual change matters. Institutional change scales it.
